PfATP4.anchor: Conserved P-type ATPase catalytic machinery: phospho-site CSDKTGT -> D451 (resi 449-458) + A-domain hinge DPPR (751-754), centroid [122.712, 125.545, 91.411]
PfATP4.anchor_justification: 9N10 (Haile et al., Nat Commun 16:9092, 2025; cryo-EM 3.7 A) has NO co-crystallized small-molecule ligand (protein-partner PfABP only) - same evidence class as the PfClpP/2F6I catalytic triad (no ligand either).
